items.title: If every object has a cover by quasi-compact objects then compact objects are summands of finite complexes of extension sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes compact objects in the derived category when every object of the site admits a cover by quasi-compact objects: they are direct summands of finite complexes of extension sheaves (statement lines 14034-14042). The proof (proof lines 14044-14057) applies the generator criterion to the extension sheaves over quasi-compact objects and checks its two hypotheses. H2: one criterion with two verifications, written out.
